title: Potocka and Mniszech to Jakub Dunin

steps.what: Acquired cached DECODE metadata for all ten records and 28 full-resolution images across nine records. R7526 has no thumbnail links in its record view; checking image manager.
Visual inspection of R7535 shows short numerical passages within mostly clear French; R7524 catalogue language is Polish. A single French-language solver across all letters is not yet justified.
Provisional transcription of R7526 numeric postscript from a full-resolution crop; retained trial separately from verified text.
French unconstrained substitution and monoalphabetic annealing failed to give coherent text.
Polish monoalphabetic annealing using shared pl-modern model gives pan starosta ... and coherent Lublin/Dominican passage. Provisional key requires image verification.

R7526 key transfers to French phrases in eight other Potocka records. Basic letter figures can be doubled (e.g. 37/74 r, 26/52 a, 25/50 e, 31/62 l, 33/66 m). This resolves Horyhorki, palatin, frere, and letter sequences.

Saved 74 provisional cipher segments from the eight Potocka records besides R7526; corrected readings with full-resolution crops. Some numerical overwrites and exceptional spellings still require review.

Separate Mniszech R7524 transcription tested with Polish quintgram homophonic annealing, a tentative hetmanow crib, and tentative null 33/ch=130. No coherent decipherment; these are hypotheses, not recovered values.

Searches for Potocka/Dunin cipher and Mniszech/Dunin cipher found biographical and archive catalogue context but no decipherment. A university project identifies Potocka as Dunin's aunt; mon fils in her letters is affectionate, not evidence of maternity.

Inspected all three cipher-key records in the local DECODE Sanguszko catalogue: R7515 numeric alphabet has different values (e.g. a=5/10/15); R7460 and R7461 are a symbol alphabet. None fits either letter family. Images saved as key candidates.
R7526 image manager supplied the missing spread; final image set is 29 across ten records.
Full all-page audit added 22 R7527 reverse segments, corrected figures, and counted 23 standalone codes; final numeric transcription has 1119 tokens.
A 232-token synthetic Polish homophonic control with 75 observed symbols recovered only 49 positions (21.1%). Mniszech search failures are inconclusive, not evidence of impossibility.
Recovered Potocka alphabet values 863/887 tokens across nine letters; literal readings retain doubtful spellings and unresolved names. R7524 remains unread.

R7526 postscript word division corrected after a report made while quotations were pulled for Lasry's list, checked on image IMG_R7526_I33996_P and r7526-trial.txt: the writer groups 21 27 20 25 36 (iakes) as one group at a line end and opens the next line with 19 27 34 29 35 17 27 32 (tancowal), so 'wtenczas iakes tancowal z nia w polu' (jakes tancowal, 'when you danced with her in the field', second person, the dancer being Dunin) replaces 'iak estancowal' (read as his staying with a woman). Letters and counts unchanged. The same image check found the name group's first figure written as 36 (s), not the transcribed 39 (p), giving Stabrowski (M alternative; transcription not yet changed).

R7526 postscript gaps re-checked on the full-resolution image for Lasry's request for a gap-free quotation: the last group's first figure is 36 (s), not 39 (p), so r7526-trial.txt token 154 corrected and the name reads Stabrowski (no 'p.'); serecki is clearly written (36 25 37 25 29 20 21), letters firm, office unidentified; the doubled dzie (21 25 30 16 21 25 30 16 21 25 30 35, evenly spaced, no cancellation) is taken as the writer's dittography, printed Iedzie <dzie> do Lublina (M). Postscript now reads continuously; counts unchanged.

R7524 re-read at full resolution from IMG_R7524_I33989_P1/P3: all 232 figures confirmed; the writer's word division (dots within words, gaps between, '=' at line breaks) recorded for the first time in r7524-words.txt (53 cipher words, single-figure words 12, 38, 56, 133; doubled 19.19 and 28.28). The clear word filed as 'Starosty horodly' is 'spraktykowawszy'.

R7524 word-boundary homophonic annealing (solve_r7524_words.py) with pl-modern and with a period model built from Pasek's memoirs (Wikisource) + Gutenberg Polish; also with cribs hetmanow and 15.20=ie.
R7524 dictionary-word annealing (solve_r7524_dict.py; 49k-word Pasek+Gutenberg list, char-model fallback): 34-36 of 53 words land in the dictionary but restarts disagree completely; no stable key.
Tested whether R7524 numbering is Potocka's table (base 14-39, homophone = 2x base) shifted (-40..40) or scaled (x1-x4).

Potocka doubtful segments re-read from the image crops: R7536 Kinisberk had a surplus 25 in the transcription (removed; total now 1118 tokens); R7536 le?itre (74/72, 21/19 run together) stays ambiguous; other doubtful words unchanged.

Measure audit: coverage.json 'valued' (77.1%) is key coverage, and 'conservative_coherent' drops whole segments by hedge words in the notes; neither measures sense. New measure_sense.py counts tokens whose word reads: Potocka 844/886 (95.3%), overall 844/1118 (75.5%).

outcome.method_basis: The Potocka alphabet was broken by Polish monoalphabetic annealing on the R7526 postscript (lang pl-modern) and transferred to the French passages of eight other letters; no outside key or reading existed. R7524 (Mniszech) is a different system and unread.
outcome.fraction_read_source: targets/potocka1714/reading-tokens.tsv: 1118 cipher tokens. fraction_read = key coverage (862 valued). fraction_coherent = word-level sense from measure_sense.py (sense.json, 5 Oct 2026): 844/1118 overall; Potocka's nine letters 844/886 = 95.3%; R7524 0/232.

gaps.detail: separate system (77 signs, 232 figures, writer's word division recorded in r7524-words.txt); no matching key or plaintext located; flat-stream, word-boundary and dictionary-word annealing (5 Oct 2026) do not converge and the matched control fails at this length; not declared impossible.
context suggests roles but does not identify exact entries; no matching nomenclator.
one occurrence, no independent key, proposed zajazd does not justify assigning a value.

gaps.item: Unread words in the Potocka letters: zaia[73]d, a Kinnik, tegn, tombap (19 tokens); other M-grade names and spellings read as sense
gaps.detail: re-read at full resolution 5 Oct 2026; the figures are as transcribed (one surplus 25 removed from Kinisberk), the words remain unestablished; no parallel witness.

outcome.notes: Potocka letters: 844/886 tokens read as sense (95.3%), measured word by word; 862/886 valued. R7524 (Mniszech, 232 tokens) unread: a separate homophonic system, 77 signs, word-divided; ciphertext-only searches with word boundaries and a period dictionary did not converge (5 Oct 2026). Overall 75.5% sense; the target stays read in part because one document (R7524) is unread.
